description: Source code for the Post model class in the Goteo project, managing blog post data including retrieval, filtering, saving, and portadas (front page entries).

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing a blog post, with methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and managing front page entries.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields that support multiple languages.

methods.name: getBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its slug, with fallback to ID if not found.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a post's data from the database, including related media, images, and author info.

methods.name: getFilteredList
methods.description: Returns a list of posts filtered by various criteria such as tags, author, section, node, etc.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all posts designated for 'home' or 'footer' positions, optionally filtered by node.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves posts for front page or footer, with filtering by node.

methods.name: getSlug
methods.description: Returns the slug or ID of the post.

methods.name: getAutocomplete
methods.description: Provides a list of posts for autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the post data, primarily checking for a title.

methods.name: slugExists
methods.description: Checks if a given slug already exists in the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the post to the database, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates specific fields of a post, such as order, home, footer.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a post from a specified position ('home' or 'footer').

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a post up in order within its position.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a post down in order within its position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for adding a new post.

methods.name: update_node
methods.description: Updates or inserts a post in a specific node's front page list.

methods.name: remove_node
methods.description: Removes a post from a specific node's front page list.

methods.name: up_node
methods.description: Moves a post up within a node's list.

methods.name: down_node
methods.description: Moves a post down within a node's list.

methods.name: next_node
methods.description: Calculates the next order value for a post within a node.

methods.name: getListSections
methods.description: Returns the list of blog sections from configuration.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns the name of a specific section.
